description: The plot illustrates how Macro-F1 Score varies with the number of tokens for two methods, “MATTER (ours)” and “w/o material information.” The x-axis is labeled “Number of tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.5 to 1.5 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, and 1.4. The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 Score (%)”, uses a linear scale, and shows values from about 48 to 58 with tick labels at 48, 50, 52, 54, 56, and 58. The “MATTER (ours)” series is drawn as a pink solid line with circular markers; it starts near 55.1 at 0.5 tokens, rises to about 57.0 at 0.8, reaches a high point around 58.0 at 1.0, then declines through roughly 53.0 at 1.2 and about 52.6 at 1.3, increases slightly to about 53.4 at 1.4, and ends near 51.0 at 1.5. The “w/o material information” series is drawn as a purple solid line with circular markers; it begins around 52.5 at 0.5 tokens, increases to about 54.0 at 0.7, then stays near 53.3 from about 0.8–0.9, gradually decreases to roughly 52.4 at 1.2 and about 51.8 at 1.3, rises to about 53.3 at 1.4, and drops to approximately 47.9 at 1.5.
